summary: Bledsoe County steel tower, believed Aermotor, beside a Tennessee Division of Forestry office; inventory lists it standing. Build date and staffing not found.

facts.design: Steel tower, believed to be an Aermotor design, with a 7x7 ft cab

access.note: Cab is locked. The register says signage on the tower states visitors may climb it. The register entry dates from about 2019; check with the Division before climbing.

events.note: Registered March 17, 2019 as US 1300, TN 35; nominated by Victoria Oliver
Tennessee inventory gives district-tower number 3-9, taken from a 1976 list of towers; this is a list number, not a build date

evidence.supports: steel tower believed to be an Aermotor design

notes_for_editor: Build date, builder, staffing and fire history are not in the NHLR entry, the Forest Lookouts listing or the tnlandforms inventory. Two web searches returned only statewide background (CCC tower counts, a 2015 Division report title) that is not cited. Aermotor is hedged by the register ('believed'). The access sign comes from a register entry of about 2018-2019; verify on site or with the Division before publishing.
